openZone.method: Family (room labelled FAMILY) area + Dining area, summed per plan. Kitchen is not listed by Metricon, so this is a lower bound on a Kitchen+Dining+Living zone; adjacency and overlap are unknown so no zone W x D is inferred.
openZone.note: area table counts each plan key (slug) once; slug collisions merge two records, so records = nRecordsFamilyPlusDining

house.note: houseWidthM x houseLengthM as printed by Metricon (normalized from payload.json). Envelope definition (garage/porch/alfresco inclusion) not verified per plan.

FamilyCore.note: compared against Family+Dining area lower bound
